negativeEvidenceReview.summary: OCC Corporate Decision 1388 approves SoFi Bank's March 27, 2026 application to establish a payment-stablecoin operating subsidiary and requires conformance with GENIUS and implementing regulations. This establishes an approved subsidiary pathway, but the letter does not identify a GENIUS PPSI approval or the subsidiary's legal name. No separate token-specific PPSI approval was located in the reviewed sources as of 2026-10-01; issuer identity remains SoFi Bank pending evidence of an actual issuance transfer.
